routing.private_proxy: existing reviewed fixed private transport; W1 freezes native/proxy port map

request.content: string or closed array of {type:text,text:string}; assistant null only with valid tool_calls
request.unsupported_media: reject before render/count/dispatch, including nested/unknown message blocks; tool schemas remain data
request.history: retain reasoning_content, full assistant calls, tool results and IDs in existing history; native template may not print tool_call_id
request.assistant_prefill: proposed disabled explicitly; caller continuation/prefill override rejected
request.reasoning_format_proposal: deepseek (reasoning_content separate), W1 verifies emitted fields
request.reasoning_off_test: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false or reasoning_effort=none; reject contradictory caller flags
request.reasoning_effort_high: not a quality guarantee; template does not consume high/low effort
request.clear_thinking: GLM only; never copy to MiMo
request.unknown_native_parameters: reject; no n_predict override, raw prompt/tokens, grammar, ignore_eos, n_keep/n_discard, arbitrary template/model/URL

generation.admission_output: one required positive safe integer, count reasoning+answer+tool output; reject conflicting aliases; reject zero/unlimited/negative
generation.stop: validated string or string array; native adds template stops and uses EOG; do not override EOS IDs
generation.finish_reason: stop/tool_calls only on WORD or EOS; LIMIT is length, including context exhaustion; incomplete tool JSON not executable

token_count.alternative: /apply-template full canonical body, then /tokenize {content:rendered_prompt,add_special:true,parse_special:true}; freeze identity/options across both
token_count.count_all: messages, tools, tool/reasoning history, developer mapping, generation prefix, native BOS/EOS and parsed special tokens

proposed_modes.kv_unified: freeze explicitly and observe; no automatic multi-slot default

capacity.native_input_predicate: P < S for causal split-capable completion
capacity.conservative_no_context_limit_predicate: P + O <= S - 1 with O>=1, ordinary one-sequence non-speculative path; source-derived proposal requiring real boundary proof
capacity.derivation: At output j, prompt cache has P+j-1 tokens; no-shift limit checks prompt.n_tokens()+1 >= S. Hold P+O<S to avoid this flag even on final requested token. No GLM -7/-2 reuse.
capacity.slot_definition: min(llama_n_ctx_seq, positive kv_unified_per_slot if set, model n_ctx_train); runtime context is padded to 256; non-unified sequence division differs from unified shared pool
capacity.swa: compact cache is architectural; distinguish from destructive context shifting and verify actual allocation

stream_and_ownership.sse_terminal: final finish/usage then [DONE] and complete HTTP drain
stream_and_ownership.response_id: backend-generated chatcmpl ID distinct from harness request UUID/session and internal integer task ID
stream_and_ownership.consumer_stop: detach consumer, continue bounded upstream drain; queued cancellation may remove before dispatch
stream_and_ownership.native_disconnect: reader destruction posts priority CANCEL tasks; cancellation is asynchronous and not GPU-idle acknowledgement
stream_and_ownership.control_endpoint: reasoning_end only in inspected dispatch; not generic stop by response ID
stream_and_ownership.timeout_or_ambiguous_eof: quarantine shared frontier owner; no retry/replay/automatic selection switch
stream_and_ownership.normal_completion: transport-complete candidate; native settlement bound must be qualified before release or model switch

authentication.native_source_flag: --api-key-file FNAME exists at pin; path only in argv, bytes never argv/env/image history
authentication.file_policy: protected root-owned regular file with safe ancestry, mode0600; nonempty single printable key validated by owner before start; read-only mount where applicable
authentication.empty_file_fail_closed: required wrapper check: native empty key list disables auth
authentication.private_proxy: authenticate and allowlist routes including health/status; raw service IPv4 loopback only
authentication.trace_logging: avoid/redact native trace key suffix output
authentication.reuse_flash_launcher: pattern only; SGLang-specific middleware cannot wrap llama unchanged

observability.up: authenticated correct alias/build/artifact/template, actual slot/allocation, warm text/tools and reserves; not static config or /health alone
observability.models_endpoint: alias/build metadata is not weight hash attestation; available while sleeping

placement.nonexperts: retain BF16/F32; selected CPU placement may be needed
placement.prefill: CPU expert and CPU nonexpert placement can execute during prefill; no KT layerwise GPU prefill equivalence or rate assumed

requires: W2 focused offline adapter/profile fixtures and separate authorized client acceptance

implementation: No production/profile/schema code changed: adapter and status proof require W1/root agreement; scoped change map in REPORT.md
